title: Maria RJ NDE 9624
content: Once I was seated in the armchair in the living room of my house, I began to lose consciousness. At that moment, the cleaning assistant was at my house, and I began to feel as if her voice was becoming more and more distant. I believe that at that moment, I lost consciousness and then I saw the edges of a silhouette come out of my body ; it was shaped like a skittle and of a deep wine/purple color. In a corner of the room, I saw a fairly wide black tunnel. In the upper left corner, there was a piece of green frame and in the upper right corner, a piece of black frame, both slightly protruding from the tunnel. I felt that part of me was beginning to leave with that silhouette, and that in leaving the body, my authentic self was really inside that silhouette. The skittle shape quickly went towards the entrance of the tunnel and at that moment, I told myself internally, and it was as if a voice had come out of me: 'I DON'T WANT TO GO THERE', and at that moment, the skittle returned very quickly to my body. Little by little, I revived and regained consciousness. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2018 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Related to heart issues Life threatening event, but not clinical death I came from the street into my house very tired, after doing some shopping, feeling tremendously fatigued. I had time to sit in the armchair in the living room of my house, and then I lost consciousness. This event was related to my heart issues, and my overexertion. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal It's as if the only thing that existed at that moment was the tunnel and the silhouette coming out of my body. As if the rest of physical reality had ceased to matter, and I don't remember perceiving it. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? was alert during the experience, but my level of consciousness before and after the experience was low. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual The experience happened very quickly. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Feeling of alertness/tension. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I heard myself yell, 'I DON'T WANT TO GO THERE,' from within, but I never yelled. It was as if I could actually hear myself thinking. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place I felt that this tunnel was taking me to an and strange place. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Fear Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Non practicing. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I did not expect to find a dark tunnel, I had always expected to find a light, or that the light would be visible at the end of the tunnel. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I told the doctor, and his reaction was one of great surprise. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Saw 'the edges of a silhouette come out of my body'; shaped like a skittle; deep wine/purple color; felt 'my authentic self was really inside that silhouette.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'fairly wide black tunnel' seen in a corner of the room, with 'a piece of green frame' upper left and 'a piece of black frame' upper right, 'both slightly protruding from the tunnel.'
tunnel.movement_other_detail: The skittle shape 'quickly went towards the entrance of the tunnel' and then 'returned very quickly to my body' after the internal statement.

environment.environment_other_detail: A wide black tunnel with protruding frame-like pieces (green upper-left; black upper-right).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She internally stated, "I DON'T WANT TO GO THERE," and the silhouette returned to her body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart issues and overexertion; became extremely fatigued after shopping, sat in an armchair, and lost consciousness.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like separation (skittle-shaped silhouette) followed by approach to a dark tunnel; immediate return after refusing internally.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer described her departing self as a deep wine/purple, skittle-shaped silhouette emerging from her body; the tunnel had protruding frame-like pieces (green upper-left; black upper-right).
